name: Mahanthesh S
summary: Recent Information Science graduate and Backend Developer specializing in Java and Spring Boot. Experienced in designing and developing scalable RESTful APIs, optimizing database performance, and implementing secure authentication using JWT and Spring Security. Proficient in PostgreSQL and Hibernate/JPA, with exposure to microservices architecture and API performance optimization.

highlights: Designed and developed scalable RESTful APIs using Spring Boot following layered architecture.
Improved DB query efficiency by ~20% using indexing and optimized joins.
Applied JWT-based authentication and role-based access control.
Integrated APIs with PostgreSQL using Hibernate/JPA and implemented validation and exception handling.
Assisted in deployment and testing of backend services on cloud platforms.

projects.title: Banking System Web Application
projects.description: Built a secure banking web application using Spring Boot REST APIs with role-based access, authentication and validation mechanisms for transaction processing.
impact: Reduced API response time by 60% using asynchronous processing and query tuning.

projects.title: Novel Journey — Novel Reading Platform
projects.description: A novel reading platform built around a Spring Boot backend and React frontend, with role-based access, secure authentication and workflow-driven content management.
impact: Implemented role-based access control using Spring Security and JWT authentication.
Optimized database queries using indexing, pagination and custom JPA queries.
Improved API response time by 30% using caching and query optimization.
Designed workflow-based systems for chapter requests, approvals and scheduled deletions with transactional consistency.
Identified and resolved API performance bottlenecks to improve response reliability.

projects.title: Blinkit Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive business dashboard created with Power BI, Power Query and DAX for visual reporting, filtering and insight discovery.
impact: Implemented dynamic filtering and interactive visuals.
Built efficient reporting using Power Query and DAX.

projects.title: M-ai-L — AI Email Agent
projects.description: Full-stack AI email assistant featuring authentication, project and agent management, OpenAI-powered conversations and Gmail integration.
impact: Generated tone-aware email replies using the OpenAI API.
Integrated Gmail API with OAuth for inbox automation and reply drafting.
Deployed a React + Express.js + PostgreSQL full-stack application.

certifications: Google Cloud Skill Badge – Prompt Design in Vertex AI
The SecOps Group – Certified Network Security Practitioner (CNSP)
